# appdynamics_database_collectors_batch_delete (Resource)

Permanently deletes a specific set of Database Visibility collectors in one call, via the (undocumented alongside the regular per-ID delete, but present) batchDelete endpoint. This models a one-shot, irreversible bulk action, not a persistent object: creating it deletes the listed collector_ids immediately, and terraform destroy is a no-op (there is no way to un-delete a collector) -- it only removes this resource from Terraform state, with a warning. Prefer managing individual collectors with appdynamics_database_collector unless you specifically need to delete several as one atomic call.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Permanently deletes these three collectors in one call, as soon as this
# resource is created. There is no way to un-delete them: terraform destroy
# only forgets this resource, it does not restore the collectors.
resource "appdynamics_database_collectors_batch_delete" "decommission" {
  collector_ids = [101, 102, 103]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collector_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the collectors to delete.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
